name: How do you choose a contractor for pool fill-in in LA?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners look for when hiring a pool fill-in contractor in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should homeowners look for when hiring a pool fill-in contractor in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a pool fill-in contractor in Los Angeles should start with scope, not just price. A strong contractor can explain whether the project is a partial removal or full removal, how drainage will be handled, what fill material will be used, how compaction will be tested, and what inspections are needed. Local experience matters because city requirements can differ between Los Angeles, Pasadena, Glendale, Burbank, and nearby jurisdictions. Homeowners should request an itemized proposal, proof of licensing and insurance, references from similar jobs, and a clear timeline. It also helps to ask who handles permits, utility coordination, soil certification, and final grading. A good contractor should be able to explain the future use of the area and tailor the method accordingly. The lowest bid is not always the safest choice if it leaves out haul-away, testing, or drainage work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor who can explain the full scope, including permits, demolition, drainage, backfill, compaction, and final grading. The best bids are itemized and specific about access, haul-away, inspection coordination, and whether soils certification is included. Experience with local city requirements matters more than the lowest price.
